release_notes: New: search now also finds your saved meals, matching either the meal's own name or the name of any ingredient inside it — searching "biryani rice" finds a meal named that, and any other meal that just happens to include it.

New: "Set as Cheat Day" on Home — the reverse of the existing "skip" offer. If you ate close to (or more than) your Cheat Day amount on some other day this week, you can make that day this week's Cheat Day instead of the one you'd configured, even after the fact (e.g. it's the end of the week, your actual Cheat Day went unused, but you clearly already had one earlier). Re-pickable if you change your mind later in the week.
